text: Need a better way to handle backing up critical Google Drive folders to encrypted offline storage, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord?
Watch DriveVault in action: Your archive is encrypted with a key derived from your private passphrase before download—zero backup vendors ever hold your keys or files.

Automatically converts cloud-native Docs, Sheets, and Slides into portable DOCX, XLSX, and PDF files inside your offline snapshot. Plus, download self-contained vault bundles straight to your local hardware so your business survives any cloud outage or account lockout.
Stop paying a second cloud company every month to store backups of files you already own. Unlock DriveVault once and back up on your schedule.
Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
